title: premna grandifolia
intro: Premna grandifolia, commonly known as Premna, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. This plant is known for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help in treating conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Premna grandifolia include its ability to act as a bronchodilator, reducing inflammation and alleviating respiratory symptoms, while also exhibiting sedative and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of Premna grandifolia include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
